description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hambantota, Hambantota D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830114 (23/0923)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details about land parcel numbers, extents, ownership information, and property classifications. The content is focused on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land-related administrative matters present.
